text: APPROVE. The helpers keep the original conditions and their order (including the `is ... or ...` precedence), so behaviour is unchanged. Splitting the method into expression-body, block-body and small predicate helpers should bring each piece well under 15, and I see nothing that would break the warnings-as-errors build. I did not build it or compute the complexity score. Two points rest on what I could not see: `IsConstantSpan` is assumed not to mutate its `locals` set, which the new shared `noLocals` relies on, and the elided part of the block loop is assumed to be unchanged.
